Async_prep design must measure both hemispheres — quantitative responsiveness metrics AND qualitative fidelity feedback loops — to avoid map-replacing-territory drift where engineering metrics optimize without building actual trust
Fidelity checks (did AI understand what was needed?) are distinct from success rates (was task executed correctly?) and both must be tracked for complete trust calibration
key_learnings_C250: Left-hemisphere reductive materialism critique applies directly to AI delegation design: pre-formatted content that strips uncertainty/context optimizes efficiency while eroding trust; clean JSON entry replaces lived reality creating silent failure even when technical metrics perfect
Two-dimensional confidence tagging required: statistical confidence (historical accuracy/N recent entries) + process fidelity signal (qualitative assessment of attentional stance preservation)

Presentational feedback channels essential: engineering metrics measure propositional knowledge; qualitative operator responses measure presentational knowledge. Both hemispheres engaged = reliable trust calibration
